topic: Present perfect or past simple
task: We ___ ___ this car since 2018, and it still runs perfectly.
wrong options / checks: bank: have | had | were | having
explanation shown to learner: *Since 2018* and we still own it: up to now, use *have* + 3rd form: *have had*, not *were having*.
explanation in Latvian: *Since 2018*, un mašīna joprojām ir mūsu: līdz šim brīdim, tāpēc lieto *have* + 3. formu: *have had*, nevis *were having*.

topic: Present perfect or past simple
task: I ___ there from 2010 to 2014. Now I work in Riga.
wrong options / checks: bank: worked | have worked | work
explanation shown to learner: A finished time (*from 2010 to 2014*, *yesterday*): past simple.
explanation in Latvian: Pabeigts laiks (*from 2010* to 2014, *yesterday*): Past Simple.

topic: Present perfect or past simple

topic: Present perfect or past simple
correct answer: I have never ridden a horse

topic: Present perfect or past simple
task: Put all the words in order. More than one answer is possible.
wrong options / checks: also accepted: did Anna see you yesterday
explanation shown to learner: After *did*, use the base form *see*. Either *you* or *Anna* can be the subject when no situation is specified.
explanation in Latvian: Pēc *did* lieto pamatformu *see*. Ja situācija nav norādīta, teikuma priekšmets var būt gan *you*, gan *Anna*.
